name: Calm Emotions
description:
You suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20 ft. sphere centered on a point within range must make a Will saving throw. If a creature fails its saving throw, you may choose one of the following effects:
- Suppress the charmed or frightened condition on the target. A suppressed effect resumes if this spell ends provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.
- Make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it has strong feelings towards. This indifference ends if the target is attacked, harmed by a spell, or witnesses its allies being harmed. When the spell ends, the creature's strong feelings return, unless the DM rules otherwise.
